description: This line plot illustrates the similarity scores across different layers for four distinct model configurations, labeled en&en, en&es, en&el, and en&bn, as indicated in the legend. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22, with integer tick marks at every two units (0, 2, 4, ..., 22). The y-axis represents the similarity score, scaled linearly from 0.00 to 0.45, with grid lines and tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The red line (en&en) starts at approximately 0.07, rises sharply to a peak of 0.26 at layer 6, then generally declines to a low of about 0.07 at layer 20 before sharply increasing to 0.44 at layer 22. The blue line (en&es) begins near 0.05, rises to a peak of 0.25 at layer 6, and then declines to a low of about 0.04 at layer 20 before rising to 0.27 at layer 22. The green line (en&el) starts near 0.04, increases to a peak of 0.19 at layer 6, then dips to a low of approximately 0.05 at layer 20 before rising to 0.30 at layer 22. The pink line (en&bn) begins at approximately 0.04, rises to a peak of 0.12 at layer 6, dips to a low of about 0.05 at layer 20, and then rises to 0.30 at layer 22. All lines show a general trend of increasing similarity in the final layers, with the red line exhibiting the highest similarity values overall, particularly at the end.
